recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure emerging from a giant, cracked robin's-egg-blue shell, kneeling in a pool of golden, honey-like viscous liquid that creates a perfect vertical reflection on a white, high-key background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the subject and her reflection
Contrast between the matte texture of the shell and the glossy sheen of the liquid
Warm amber tones of the liquid against the cool teal of the shell
Organic, dripping forms juxtaposed with the sharp, jagged edges of the broken shell
coreInvariants: Perfect mirror reflection on the horizontal axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, occupying the middle horizontal third, with the reflection occupying the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point where the figure's hand touches the liquid pool, bridging the subject and reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the figure's face, follows the dripping liquid down to the reflection, then circles back up through the curved edges of the egg shell.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white space surrounding the central cluster, emphasizing the isolation of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background providing a clean, clinical environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted teal/robin's-egg blue of the shell exterior.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden amber/honey tones of the liquid and skin highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout, with saturation concentrated in the amber liquid and the figure's skin tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio shot of a woman with long dark hair emerging from a giant, cracked teal egg shell. She is kneeling in a thick, translucent golden syrup. The entire scene is set against a seamless white background with a perfectly reflective floor creating a vertical mirror image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, high-contrast serif font placed in the upper or lower quadrants of the white negative space to maintain the central focus.

verificationChecks: Does the liquid have a realistic viscous, stringy texture?
Is the background pure white without shadows at the edges?
Is the egg shell's interior a lighter, creamy color compared to the teal exterior?

mustRedesign: Any specific facial features to avoid likeness issues

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the subject
Realistic liquid physics (drips and surface tension)

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the reflection
Ensure the golden liquid looks translucent rather than opaque
Verify the white background is blown out and seamless
Confirm the jagged edges of the shell look sharp and structural
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + Surrealist Prop (Cracked Egg) + Viscous Element (Honey/Syrup) + Symmetrical Reflection + High-Key Studio Lighting.
